blind.description: A square architectural pillar featuring a molded base plinth, a shaft composed of recessed square panels, and a flared, flat-topped capital. The middle section of the shaft consists of a reddish-brown/copper-toned band, while the rest of the column is dark charcoal grey/black stone or painted wood. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or fused blobs. The flat underside rests flush on the ground.
blind.from_above: A solid dark grey square with rounded corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.4 to 1.5 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 8 to 8.5 feet tall), and slightly wider than the figure's cylinder diameter.
